rules.statement: A security bond given by a surety can be enforced in the same action as the original judgment, provided that the surety is first notified to show cause why the bond should not be forfeited.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Supreme Court held Ukku that when a person has bound himself as a surety for the performance by a party to a legal proceeding of a judgment or order in such proceeding, he may be proceeded against in the same proceeding for the forfeiture of his bond and the recovery of the amount thereof, but he must, in the first instance, be noticed to show cause why the bond should not be forfeited and the amount should not be recovered from him."
